title: BiocHandoff
text:
Package: BiocHandoffAuthors: Vincent Carey [aut, cre]Compiled: 2025-07-22Package version: 0.98.1R version: R version 4.5.1 (2025-06-13)BioC version: 3.22License: MIT + file LICENSE
Welcome
This is the landing page of the BiocBook entitled “BiocHandoff”.
This book introduces the reader to tasks required as staff members leave the organization.
We prefer a computable book to a static text or spreadsheet so that computations can be included and checked.
Docker image
A Docker image built from this repository is available here:
👉 ghcr.io/vjcitn/biochandoff 🐳






Get started now 🎉



You can get access to all the packages used in this book in < 1 minute, using this command in a terminal:



bash

docker run -it ghcr.io/vjcitn/biochandoff:devel R




RStudio Server
An RStudio Server instance can be initiated from the Docker image as follows:



bash

docker run \
    --volume <local_folder>:<destination_folder> \
    -e PASSWORD=OHCA \
    -p 8787:8787 \
    ghcr.io/vjcitn/biochandoff:devel


The initiated RStudio Server instance will be available at https://localhost:8787.
